root_causes.root_cause: _recover_picture_text decorative_icon filter (converters.py:2150-2157) and _PICTURE_OCR_MIN_CHARS threshold (20 chars) discard small icon/checkmark PictureItems as decorative. For documents where icons carry semantic content (checkmark=included, no-checkmark=excluded), this drops the document's core data. splice_figure_markers then has no enrichment data for these regions, and _enrich_image_blocks skips blocks without valid PictureResult index matches. RFC-034 C6 explicitly defers this as high-complexity.
root_causes.suggested_fix: Per-cell VLM/OCR enrichment for icon-class PictureItems when they appear in table contexts (checkmark pattern detection). RFC-034 C6 deferred this; requires Docling cell-coordinate API or per-cell VLM calls. Alternative: lower DECORATIVE_ICON_MIN_DIM_PT for documents with high icon density and classify checkmark presence as binary metadata.

root_causes.root_cause: _enrich_image_blocks (client.py:699) unconditionally overwrites ocr_text when block has none, but splice_picture_text_for_tree (converters.py:2292) previously popped ocr_text from PictureResults via pic.pop(). For standalone images (.jpg), the synthetic PictureResult carries OCR text but gets zero bounding box. The enrichment path lacks chart-structure analysis (series extraction, numeric label parsing). RFC-034 D19 fix (density comparison guard) is implemented in uncommitted working tree but was not deployed for Run 18.
root_causes.suggested_fix: Deploy the uncommitted D19 fix (density comparison guard in _enrich_image_blocks) which is already implemented in the working tree. For chart-structure enrichment, this requires VLM (vlm_describe_images config gate) which is user-locked off (Granite rejected).

needs_doc_drilldown.reason: Run 16 had 60/63 unenriched (3 enriched) but Run 18 has 63/63 unenriched with 3 identical boilerplate enrichments -- the worsening of those 3 markers needs investigation. Possible causes: remote Docling service version skew changing PictureItem classification boundaries, or the 3 boilerplate enrichments are from a different source (description field vs ocr_text). The shared root cause PO-1 explains the 60/63 baseline but not the 60->63 regression.
